blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 36-year-old Chinese national was injured on Tuesday after allegedly jumping off an elevated section of the Cavite Expressway (Cavitex) in Bacoor City. He was reportedly attempting to evade authorities who accosted him for riding an electric bicycle (e-bike) at the tollway. The Chinese national, a resident of Pasay City, rode an e-bike through Cavitex at around 3 p.m., prompting a security patrol officer to intercept him because such vehicles are prohibited on national highways and major thoroughfares, according to a police report on Wednesday.
